source_text:
Homilia habita in ecclesia Cyrini
Τοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐξ ὁμιλίας ῥηθείσης ἐν τῇ Κυρίνου ἐκκλησίᾳ,
τρισκαιδεκάτῃ τοῦ φαμενὼθ μηνὸς κατ' Αἰγυπτίους, ἐν ᾗ τὸ τοῦ Ἠσαΐου
ῥητὸν ἑρμηνεύει τὸ φάσκον· Κατέπιεν ὁ θάνατος ἰσχύσας καὶ πάλιν
thought_title: Heading and lemma of the homily
orientation: This is the title and opening lemma of Cyril's homily, introducing the Isaiah text he will interpret.
pass_a_gloss: Of the same [author] from a homily spoken in the church of Cyrinus, on the thirteenth of the month Phamenoth according to [the] Egyptians, in which the saying of Isaiah he interprets, the [one] saying: Death swallowed having prevailed and again

choices.why: Standard attribution formula indicating the same author as the preceding work.
Preserves the genitive construction and the passive participle's force.
rejected: out of a homily that was said

choices.why: Literal rendering of the place name in the genitive.

choices.term: τρισκαιδεκάτῃ τοῦ φαμενὼθ μηνὸς κατ' Αἰγυπτίους
choices.english: on the thirteenth of the month Phamenoth according to the Egyptians
choices.why: Keeps the ordinal, month name, and the phrase 'according to the Egyptians' as in the source.
rejected: on the 13th of Phamenoth by Egyptian reckoning
on Phamenoth 13 in the Egyptian calendar

choices.term: ἐν ᾗ τὸ τοῦ Ἠσαΐου ῥητὸν ἑρμηνεύει τὸ φάσκον
choices.english: in which he interprets the saying of Isaiah which says
choices.why: Preserves the relative clause structure and the present tense of 'interprets'.
rejected: where he explains the text of Isaiah that reads
in which the saying of Isaiah is interpreted, which says

choices.why: Keeps the aorist verb, the nominative subject, and the adverbial participle's force.

pass_b_english: Of the same, from a homily delivered in the church of Cyrinus on the thirteenth of the month Phamenoth according to the Egyptians, in which he interprets the saying of Isaiah which says: "Death swallowed, having prevailed, and again" (Isaiah 25:8).

problems.source_quote: Κατέπιεν ὁ θάνατος ἰσχύσας καὶ πάλιν
problems.why: The English cites Isaiah 25:8 but the source text breaks off mid-quotation after καὶ πάλιν, not containing the full verse quoted in English.
problems.fix: Omit the parenthetical citation or mark as incomplete quotation.
problems.ruling: Source breaks off after καὶ πάλιν; English adds 'God removed every tear...' and 'Isaiah 25:8', not in source.

edits.old: "Death swallowed, having prevailed, and again God removed every tear from every face" (Isaiah 25:8).

fixed: The English quoted the full verse, but the source text breaks off after καὶ πάλιν, so the quotation was truncated to match the source while retaining the citation.

last_rejected.source_quote: Κατέπιεν ὁ θάνατος ἰσχύσας καὶ πάλιν
last_rejected.why: Quoted text omits 'God removed every tear' but cites Isaiah 25:8 as whole verse.
last_rejected.fix: Add ellipsis or partial citation: "Death swallowed, having prevailed, and again..." (Isaiah 25:8).
last_rejected.ruling: Source quotes only 'Κατέπιεν ὁ θάνατος ἰσχύσας καὶ πάλιν'; English faithfully renders that excerpt with Isaiah 25:8 reference.
